    • display

      public abstract void display()
      Abstract method to display the current view. Must be implemented by subclasses to define how each specific view is rendered on the screen.

    • displayPlayerStats

      protected void displayPlayerStats(com.googlecode.lanterna.graphics.TextGraphics tg) throws IOException
      Displays player statistics such as level, health, experience, and available actions ('M' for Map, 'I' for Inventory, 'S' for RoomView) at the bottom of the screen.
      Parameters:
      tg - TextGraphics object used for rendering text on the terminal.
      Throws:
      IOException - If an I/O error occurs.

    • drawTitle

      protected void drawTitle(com.googlecode.lanterna.TextColor textColor)
